subject: Your 45-day milestone is here
preview_text: You've reached a turning point. Here's what changes now for you and your partner.
body_paragraphs: It's been 45 days since you started planning together. That's not just a number—it's 45 nights where you chose connection over routine. Most couples don't make it past week three. You did. And that changes something.

Here's the truth: you're not a new user anymore. You're part of a small group that actually uses the app to keep the spark alive. The next chapter isn't about discovering features—it's about owning this habit. The couples who reach this point and open the app today plan 4x more dates next month. It's not magic. It's momentum.

Open your Memory Timeline tonight. Scroll back to your first date card—the one you planned together. Look at what you wrote. Then tap 'Tonight's Date' and pick a mood that's been missing lately. That's your next chapter: not more planning, but deeper connection.

One tap on Tonight's Date and you'll see a card waiting for you. Open it now. It's the only way to keep the streak alive without pressure. P.S. — Your partner won't see this email, but they'll see that you opened the app tonight.
